description: Design DNA extracted from 5 major marketplace platforms. Marketplaces are dual-sided platforms connecting buyers and sellers, with prominent search, category-driven navigation, and heavy emphasis on trust signals.

palette.primary_role: Brand-differentiating accent used for primary CTAs, active states, and brand markers. Fiverr=green, Upwork=yellow/gold, Etsy=purple/orange, Thumbtack=blue/teal, TaskRabbit=green. Common theme: warm, approachable, non-corporate colors.
palette.accent_role: Secondary emphasis -- Etsy uses orange as heritage accent, Upwork uses navy for button text, others use warm coral/orange for urgency/action.
palette.surface_role: Background hierarchy: white for main content, light gray (#F5-F9) for alternating sections, darker gray for footer/subtle differentiation. Etsy uses dark mode (#131313) as default.
palette.neutral_role: Body text in dark gray (#464-#222) rather than pure black. Upwork uses #464646, Fiverr uses #222325. Secondary text lighter gray.
palette.border_role: Card borders and input outlines, typically light gray, subtle.

body_fonts: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

border_radius.buttons: 4px-8px (pill: 9999px for primary CTA on Fiverr, 7px on Upwork)
border_radius.inputs: 4px-8px (border-radius on search bars tighter: 2px Etsy, 24px-9999px pill-style common)

elevation.shadows: Subtle and functional -- cards get shadow on hover (0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.08-0.12)), not heavy material-design shadows. Etsy had flat design (no shadows on cards). Upwork also flat (box-shadow: none).

typical_order: header (sticky, logo left, prominent search bar center, user menu + CTAs right, often transparent or white bg)
hero (massive search bar + category tiles/links + trust logos row -- 'what do you need?' messaging, dual tab for buy/sell)
categories grid (icon/image + label, 6-12 categories, colorful icons on white/light bg)
popular/trending listings (carousel or 4-6 column grid of cards with photo+title+price+rating+seller)
how it works (3-step visual for buyers, separate 3-step for sellers/providers -- dual-track)
trust/social proof (review stats, testimonial carousel, badge showcase: verified, insured, background-checked)
pricing plans / featured tiers (not always -- Upwork has this, others skip)
call to action (join as seller / become a provider -- dual CTA prominent)
footer (massive category sitemap in 4-6 columns, about/support/legal links, app download badges, social links, locale selector)

hero_variants.description: Large centered search input (often 600-800px wide) with popular category chips/links below. Tab selector for 'I want to hire' / 'I want to work' on dual-sided marketplaces.
hero_variants.structure: h1 headline → subheading → search bar (with dual tabs on work marketplaces) → category chips/links → trust logos row

hero_variants.description: Etsy places the main search in the sticky header rather than the hero. Hero becomes a shoppable banner/carousel with editorial photography and subtle CTAs.
hero_variants.structure: shoppable image card(s) → headline overlay → 'Shop now' CTA

hero_variants.description: Full-bleed lifestyle photo background with search overlay. Common for TaskRabbit-style service marketplaces.
hero_variants.structure: background photo → overlay → h1 ('What do you need done?') → search input + location → task category tiles

card_variants.elements: seller avatar + name + rating stars + review count + service title/description + price (starting at) + delivery time
card_variants.hover: subtle shadow lift, sometimes seller info overlay

card_variants.elements: large photo (square or 4:3) + title + shop name + price + rating stars + review count + favorite button
card_variants.hover: photo zoom or second image swap

card_variants.elements: circular or rounded-square icon/illustration + category label
provider photo + name + rating + review count + skills/tags + 'background checked' badge + starting rate

tone_profile.headline_style: Conversational and action-oriented. Marketplaces use inclusive, empowering language (e.g., 'Work at the speed of your ambition' - Upwork, 'It needs a human touch' - Fiverr). Headlines address the dual audience: buyers want speed/quality/trust, sellers want opportunity/community/income.
tone_profile.cta_style: Dual CTAs are universal: primary CTA targets buyers ('Browse', 'Find', 'Search', 'Hire'), secondary CTA targets sellers ('Start selling', 'Join', 'Become a pro', 'Find work'). Primary CTA is always the brightest button, usually filled with brand color.
trust_signals: Star ratings (1-5) prominently displayed on every card
Badge system: verified, top-rated, background-checked, insured
Trusted by [N] businesses/clients stat in hero
anti_patterns: DO NOT use corporate/enterprise tone -- marketplaces are community-first
DO NOT hide search -- search is THE primary navigation pattern
DO NOT single-sided messaging -- always address both buyers and sellers
DO NOT hide trust signals behind tabs -- they must be surface-level visible
DO NOT use dark/aggressive color palettes -- stay warm and approachable
DO NOT bury categories -- category browsing is equal to search for discovery

color_mood: Warm marketplace (Etsy/Fiverr) -- orange/green accents, human warmth, creative energy, rounded forms, friendly typography
Professional marketplace (Upwork/Thumbtack) -- blue/navy accents, clean white space, structured layouts, professional typography, more corporate but still approachable
typography_mood: Geometric modern (Fiverr/TaskRabbit) -- Macan-style geometric sans, tight letter-spacing, modern tech feel
Humanist warm (Etsy/Upwork) -- system fonts or Muli-style humanist sans, natural reading rhythm, approachable
layout_density: Dense discovery (Etsy) -- tight grid of product cards, maximize items per view, infinite scroll feel, dark mode for reduced eye strain
Spaced guidance (Upwork/TaskRabbit) -- generous whitespace, one idea per section, guided journey from search to hire, light mode

search.placement: always prominent -- in sticky header (Etsy) or as hero centerpiece (all others)
search.behavior: type-ahead suggestions, popular searches as placeholder rotation, category scope selector sometimes attached
search.size: large -- typically 48-56px height, 500-800px width in hero context

navigation.primary: sticky header with logo left, search center, user/auth right
navigation.secondary: category dropdown/mega-menu below header OR horizontal scroll of category links
navigation.mobile: bottom tab bar (Etsy: Home, Search, Favorites, Cart, Account) or hamburger menu

cards.save_behavior: heart/bookmark button in corner (often shows on hover)
cards.quick_view: sometimes available on hover for product marketplaces

layout_archetype.name: Search-first dual-sided marketplace
layout_archetype.core_layout: Header (sticky) → Hero (search + categories) → How it works → Popular listings → Trust proof → CTA (join/sell) → Footer (category sitemap)
layout_archetype.grid_system: CSS Grid or Flexbox, 4-5 column card grids on desktop, collapsing to 2 columns on tablet, 1 column on mobile
layout_archetype.content_width: 1200-1300px max width, centered, with generous padding on sides
